claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Arbe 之後的 6-K 寫出 robotaxi 訂單取消、路測結束未轉量產，或整套雷達產線停產。核查頻率：每季（Arbe 6-K）。觸發後 48 小時：拿掉 Arbe→車用雷達這條邊的量含意，ARBE 敘事重答需求格。
claims.statement: Arbe Q1 2026 release: Arbe began shipping chipsets to Hirain for its L4 project with a Chinese automaker, began selling full radar systems from a dedicated production line, and received additional orders from global robotaxi players using its Phoenix radar for L4 360-degree sensing. Supplier self-report; robotaxi customers are not named and order sizes are not stated.

source_doc.title: Arbe Robotics 6-K（2026-05-28，Q1 2026 財報新聞稿）：開始出貨晶片組給 Hirain 的 L4 專案、開始賣整套雷達（自建產線）、robotaxi 業者用 Phoenix 追加訂單

sources.locator: Q1 2026 新聞稿 — 開始出貨給 Hirain
sources.quote: Arbe began shipping chipsets to Hirain for its L4 project which it announced in December: Hirain, Arbe’s Tier 1, is using Arbe’s chipset for a high-resolution 48x48 imaging radar project with a Chinese automaker.

sources.locator: Q1 2026 新聞稿 — 開始賣整套雷達
sources.quote: Arbe begins sales of full radar systems: This complements Arbe’s chipset offerings. Arbe has established a dedicated production line to manufacture its radar systems.

sources.locator: Q1 2026 新聞稿 — robotaxi 追加訂單
sources.quote: Arbe received additional orders from global robotaxi players using Phoenix to support L4 autonomy with 360-degree sensing.
